issues.quote: Agnes met Theodor in her office wearing an emerald outfit
from which straps fell to support her full breasts, moderately styled and dotted with moles
It also left her supple shoulders and womanly belly bare, the muscles beneath it moving
gold nails made of remelted etons
and the Pigsty's discipline regarding high collars and robes was upheld by resident mages who had already graduated, right up to gray hair and the grave
Agnes's green robe on the hanger behind her did nothing to improve matters
For the tutors appointed at the end of the fourth circle held nearly unlimited power. Because, besides examinations,
they steered a mage's path all the way to expulsion or graduation
And there were a great many very juicy rumors
A combat magess and veteran, Agnes did not even have a fifth-circle diploma, and, according to the rumors, she had not served her ten years as a combat magess either.

strengths.quote: it was covered in sequins that threw the morning sun across the walls like an emerald disco ball
Three versions circulated about a three-day orgy in the rectorate. Two more added that Senators and Minor Gods took part.
